619-1719-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
619-1719-2645-3430.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

671-1263-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
671-1263-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Daxos and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

719-5330-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-5330-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1453-2921-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-2921-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.

2869-3184-4247--173.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature that costs {0}.
Yomiji triggers, returning that creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1308-2557-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1619-4605-5542-6144-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6144-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6144-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3532-5060-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5060-5078-7750.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1494-1742-6822-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

193-2369-4377-4423.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter on it, blinking Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.
193-2369-4377-4423.notes: Mystic Sanctuary can be tapped for mana before casting Walk the Aeons if it's able to do so.

1978-2416-7434--148.notablePrerequisites:
There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
1978-2416-7434--148.description:
Animate Brass Infiniscope.
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
1978-2416-7434--148.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

6913-7009-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
6913-7009-7334.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering its ability, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2457-3000-4289-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1069-2457-4742-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-4742-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

57-283-4785-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4785-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1473-4186-5870.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2374-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2374-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1330-2164-5872.easyPrerequisites: You have another card in hand.
1330-2164-5872.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Truefire Captain indestructible.
1330-2164-5872.description:
Give Truefire Captain indestructible, if needed.
Cast Chain of Plasma by paying {1}{R}, dealing 3 damage to Truefire Captain and causing you to discard a card and copy Chain of Plasma targeting Truefire Captain.
Taii Wakeen and Truefire Captain trigger.
Resolve the Taii Wakeen trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Truefire Captain trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Chain of Plasma copy, dealing 3 damage to Truefire Captain and causing you to discard a card and copy Chain of Plasma targeting Truefire Captain.
Repeat from step 3.

394-856-5256-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1350-6478--85.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 7 or greater.
1350-6478--85.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least seven {G} or {W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

108-4499-6441.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1274-4968.notablePrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1274-4968.description:
Activate Heliod by paying {1}{W}, giving Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink until end of turn.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat from step 2.

239-1636-2467-4465-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
At most two mana of any two different colors available, plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
239-1636-2467-4465-5072.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Cast Sliver Grandmother from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Sliver Grandmother enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priortiy, activate Sliver Gravemother by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Activate Sliver Gravemother by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Choose not to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Sliver Gravemother's encore ability by paying {5} and exiling it.
Choose to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from exile.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, creating a token copy of it for each opponent you have.
When the Sliver Gravemother tokens enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate the Sliver Gravemother tokens by tapping them, adding at least three mana of any color(s).
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Repeat from step 15 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

914-1235-4125.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1235-4125.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist and Shipwreck Dowser with haste.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1008-2645.notablePrerequisites: Undermountain Adventurer does not have summoning sickness. You've completed a dungeon.
1008-2645.description:
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding six {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Undermountain Adventurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
1008-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
